metadata.title: Claude, Skeptical
metadata.subtitle: Professor Bear's notes on Saloni's job-fit checker
metadata.audience: Computational Skepticism students (INFO 7375) and anyone building decision-support tools
metadata.derived_from: Saloni's final-project proposal + Computational-Skepticism feedback prompt
metadata.framing: Liam asks Claude what feedback Professor Bear would give the student. FIRST NAME ONLY — 'Saloni', 'Professor Bear' / 'Bear'. Never the student's surname.
metadata.one_idea: In Computational Skepticism the skepticism has to be load-bearing, not decorative: the test of Saloni's job-fit checker is whether it names its target, gates work authorization instead of scoring it, breaks under realistic perturbation, and shows its own uncertainty.
